PM Modi Urges Citizens to Hoist National Flag for Independence Day

Prime Minister Narendra Modi has appealed to citizens to hoist the national flag at their homes ahead of Independence Day on August 15. The appeal was made through a video shared on social media platforms. The Prime Minister encouraged the public to make the 'Har Ghar Tiranga' (Tricolour at Every Home) initiative a celebration.
